values.binNote: AsheQ.ShotsPerStrike is a flat 5 for every flurry, and no data value in the AsheQ block carries a 6-arrow count or a 1.2x/20% multiplier, so this wiki-only first-flurry bonus has no visible bin support at all. It may be scripted outside the dumped data values, or the wiki text could be stale for 16.18. The 132/138/144/150/156% figures are derived purely from the wiki's own ad1/ad5 vardefines x1.2, unconfirmed by the bin.

mechanics.claim: Casting Ranger's Focus (each empowered attack while it is active) resets Ashe's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: ''Ranger's Focus {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Ashe's''' basic attack timer.''

mechanics.claim: An empowered flurry deals 1 instance of basic damage followed by 4 instances of a non-reactive (default or proc) damage type.
mechanics.quote: The flurries deal 1 instance of {{tip|basic damage}} followed by 4 instances of a non-reactive type of damage

mechanics.claim: A flurry applies on-hit effects only once despite dealing 5 separate damage instances.
The very first flurry of each Ranger's Focus activation fires one extra arrow (six total) instead of five.
mechanics.quote: one additional arrow, dealing 20% increased total damage.
